jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Strategy & Operations Associate



San Francisco, CA: Financial District. In-Person (M-F) 



We are very excited to be hiring our first Strategy & Operations (BizOps) Associate. You'll go wherever the operation is breaking, scope the problem, build the fix, and hand it off. And you'll do it AI-natively — we expect the person in this seat to replace manual work with agents and internal tooling rather than absorb it as headcount. How we run ourselves internally should look like the product we sell: it's part of our advantage, not back-office overhead.

Finance operations and reporting are the anchor — the numbers, the close, the board deck, the dashboard everyone actually looks at — but the role doesn't stop at Finance. You'll sit at the center of the company, supporting both sides of the org: GTM (sales, marketing, product, customer success) and Engineering & Design. You'll work directly with the founders and every function lead here. Most of what you'll own doesn't exist yet — you'll be the one who builds it.

No two weeks look the same, and that's the point. You'll report to the Chief of Staff and rotate across finance operations, GTM reporting, and eng/design operations — owning real work in each, not observing. The scope is wide because the company moves fast and the problems don't respect org charts. This role is for someone genuinely comfortable with ambiguity - scopes shifts week to week.



Why FurtherAI?

 - Elite Team & Culture: Join a YC and a16z-backed startup, collaborating with industry experts who share your hunger and ambition. Be part of a culture built for high performers who are proud to put in the work.

 - Transformative Opportunity: Sell pioneering AI solutions in complex, regulated industries and help modernize a trillion-dollar sector.

 - Leadership Growth: Leverage your experience to shape our sales process and grow into a senior leadership role as the company scales.

 - Highly Competitive Compensation: Strong base salary, top-tier commission plan, equity, and comprehensive benefits.





What You'll Do

 - Put AI to work inside FurtherAI. Find the work people are doing that AI should be doing instead. Build AI workflows and internal tooling that eliminate manual steps across finance and ops, and become the person the team comes to for what's worth automating and how.

 - Support FinOps and cost discipline. Track infrastructure and vendor costs, pull the analysis that shows where the money is going, flag what looks off, and support the work to bring it down.

 - Build the reporting the company runs on. Create and maintain the KPI dashboards, board materials, and recurring reports leadership actually uses to make decisions — revenue, pipeline, burn, headcount, and beyond.

 - Support GTM. Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product and Customer Success on pipeline hygiene, forecasting, and the data and materials they need to hit the number.

 - Support Engineering & Design. Partner with Engineering and Design on headcount and hiring plans, tooling, and the operational rhythm that keeps a fast-moving product org organized.

 - Run cross-functional projects end to end. Pricing analyses, market sizing, competitive research, fundraising prep, or whatever ambiguous work doesn't belong to any one team — you scope it, run it, and land it, working with the COO/Chief of Staff to prioritize what matters most this week.

 - Own the mechanics of money moving in and out. Vendor onboarding and payments, customer invoicing, billing accuracy, collections follow-up, and expense workflows, plus the monthly close, cash tracking, and budget-vs-actuals. Turn what lives in someone's inbox into a process that runs on its own.



Who You Are

 - You've been the best at something — top of your class, captain of the team, first in your cohort — and you're looking for the next thing to pour that into.

 - At every past job you ended up doing more than your title said.

 - You have a builder's instinct for process — when something breaks twice, you redesign it; when a task eats four hours every week, you make it run itself.

 - You're as comfortable in a spreadsheet or financial model as you are in a room with Sales or Engineering.

 - You get energy from moving fast across many problems, not sitting in one lane.

 - You'd rather own a messy problem end-to-end than execute a clean task someone handed you.

 - You context-switch without losing intensity, and you care about outcomes over job descriptions.



Requirements

 - 2–4+ years in a high-paced environment - MBB, Investment Banking, or similar required.

 - Genuinely AI-native — you already use LLMs and agents as leverage in your own work and have built things with them, not just used a chatbot to draft an email.

 - Strong financial and analytical skills — comfortable building and stress-testing a model, not just reading one, and pulling your own numbers without waiting on someone else.

 - Extremely high attention to detail — this role touches money moving in and out of the company, and small errors are expensive.

 - Strong written and verbal communication across Finance, GTM, and Engineering — you can write a crisp update, chase an overdue invoice professionally, and explain a process to someone with no context.

 - Bias toward action; based in San Francisco or willing to relocate immediately.



Nice to Have

 - Prior experience in Insurtech, Fintech, etc, or B2B SaaS at a high-growth technology company.

 - Hands-on experience with financial systems (QuickBooks, NetSuite, Ramp, Rippling, or similar) and BI/reporting or internal-tooling platforms (Looker, Retool, Sigma, Zapier, or similar).

 - Prior startup or founder experience.

 - Exposure to sales/GTM operations and/or engineering program management.



You can look forward to the following benefits:

 - Fully covered, best-in-class health, dental, and vision benefits

 - Competitive Compensation, meaningful stock options, company 401(k)

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Outstanding in-office culture in the heart of San Francisco

 - Lunch and dinner onsite

 - Team events, such as happy hours and off-sites

 - Commuter benefits

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Director
jobs.description:
Enterprise Sales Director



New York: Just signed on a new office in Manhattan! 
In-Person (M-F) 



FurtherAI is seeking a driven Enterprise Sales Director to help lead our next phase of growth. This is a high-impact, in-person role based in New York, working closely with our founders and early sales team. You will define and close high-value enterprise deals, drive revenue, and directly shape the trajectory of the company.



Why FurtherAI?

 - Elite Team & Culture: Join a YC and a16z-backed startup, collaborating with industry experts who share your hunger and ambition. Be part of a culture built for high performers who are proud to put in the work.

 - Transformative Opportunity: Sell pioneering AI solutions in complex, regulated industries and help modernize a trillion-dollar sector.

 - Leadership Growth: Leverage your experience to shape our sales process and grow into a senior leadership role as the company scales.

 - Highly Competitive Compensation: Strong base salary, top-tier commission plan, equity, and comprehensive benefits.



What You Bring (Non-Negotiables):

 - Recent, Top-Performer Experience: Have directly carried quota and consistently ranked at (or near) the top among sales peers in enterprise or mid-market (if exceptional) B2B environments.

 - Enterprise Sales Focus: Track record of closing complex enterprise deals; ability to own and drive the full sales cycle, ideally in SaaS or related tech sectors.

 - Early-Stage Prowess: Early-stage startup experience is essential (preferably with a successful, high-growth company). Experience reporting to founders is a major plus.

 - In-Person Presence: Willing and able to work on-site in San Francisco 5 days per week (with some flexibility as needed). Someone who thrives on energy, collaboration, and pace of an office environment.

 - Unmatched Drive: Demonstrated hunger to win, grit, and a willingness to do what it takes – open to long days, eager to learn, and motivated to prove yourself in a demanding environment.

 - Cultural Alignment: Thrives in high-ownership, high-urgency cultures. Not afraid to roll up your sleeves and handle ambiguity and chaos.



Nice to Have (Not Required):

 - Experience selling into insurance or other regulated industries

 - Background in insurtech or fintech

 - Familiarity with founder-led sales environments (YC, a16z, or similar)



Key Responsibilities:

 - Lead the entire enterprise sales cycle from opportunity to close, partnering directly with founders and cross-functional teams.

 - Build and manage a robust pipeline of enterprise prospects, proactively driving deals.

 - Deeply understand client needs and pain points, and develop tailored solutions leveraging FurtherAI’s platform.

 - Act as the primary point of contact for clients through discovery, demos, negotiations, and account management.

 - Provide clear, accurate forecasts and CRM updates; collaborate closely with SDR, product, and marketing teams.

 - Contribute to ongoing improvements in our sales strategy, pitch, and go-to-market approach.



If you’re a top performer yearning to prove yourself in a transformative role, let’s talk!



Apply now to help build a generational company alongside a world-class team, backed by top investors and founders.



You can look forward to the following benefits:

 - Fully covered, best-in-class health, dental, and vision benefits

 - Competitive Compensation, meaningful stock options, company 401(k)

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Outstanding in-office culture in the heart of San Francisco

 - Lunch and dinner onsite

 - Team events, such as happy hours and off-sites

 - Commuter benefits

jobs.title: Founding Social & Brand Director
jobs.description:
Founding Social & Brand Director — FurtherAI


Full-time in SF or NY | In-person | 5-9+ years of relevant experience required



FurtherAI is building the AI Workspace for Insurance, empowering underwriters, brokers, and carriers to automate routine work so they can focus on higher-value decisions. We move fast, prioritize clarity and quality, and tell stories that matter to one of the world’s most critical industries.



We’re seeking a Founding Social & Brand Director to drive our brand’s growth across LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and other key channels. You’ll partner directly with our VP of Growth Marketing and founders, taking ownership of the entire social process — from planning and content creation to publishing and community engagement. If you thrive in early-stage, fast-paced environments and enjoy translating complex topics into simple, compelling content, we’d love to meet you.


What You’ll Do:

 - Manage FurtherAI’s social media presence on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and other platforms

 - Plan, draft, schedule, and publish daily or weekly content that aligns with our brand voice

 - Collaborate closely with the VP of Growth Marketing on campaign launches, product updates, events, and thought leadership

 - Research competitors and trends to keep our content sharp and differentiated

 - Edit and publish short-form video (YouTube Shorts) — proficiency required

 - Engage with our community: respond to comments, monitor DMs, and track growth

 - Analyze performance metrics and use insights to iterate and improve reach and impact

 - Support the creation of content for paid social campaigns

 - Contribute creative ideas for formats, hooks, scripts, and new angles



What We’re Looking For:

 - 5-9+ years of full-time experience in social media, brand, content creation, or digital marketing

 - Previous experience in a startup environment, ideally early-stage

 - Background in B2B SaaS or AI is a major plus

 - Strong storytelling skills and ability to distill complex ideas into clear content

 - Exceptional writing skills: crisp, concise, and human — not AI-generated style

 - Comfortable moving quickly, handling ambiguity, taking feedback, and iterating fast

 - Strong design sense and ability to deliver polished copy

 - Proficiency with video editing and design tools (Adobe, Canva, Figma) preferred 

 - Analytical mindset: you care about data and what drives results

 - Based in San Francisco and available for in-person work



Who This Role Is Not For:
This position may not be suitable if you:

 - Prefer slower-paced or highly structured environments

 - Have not owned a social channel end-to-end before

 - Are uncomfortable with high-volume writing

 - Need multiple rounds of approval before posting

 - Want to manage agencies rather than create content hands-on

 - Favor brand marketing over hands-on execution

 - Are not based in San Francisco or able to work in-person

 - Do not thrive with fast feedback loops and high standards



Why Join FurtherAI:

 - Shape the voice of one of the fastest-growing AI companies in insurance

 - Own and operate all social channels with extensive autonomy

 - Work with a team that values clarity, speed, and top-notch craftsmanship

 - Tell meaningful stories in a legacy industry undergoing transformative change

 - Receive a competitive salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits

 - Join a team that moves fast, writes well, and is committed to high-quality work



You can look forward to the following benefits:

 - Fully covered, best-in-class health, dental, and vision benefits

 - Competitive Compensation & meaningful stock options

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Outstanding in-office culture in the heart of San Francisco

 - Lunch and dinner onsite

 - Team events, such as happy hours and off-sites

 - Commuter benefits

 - Company 401(k)
